description: Use when the traveler asks how much data they need, without choosing a plan yet. Returns estimated_gb for the trip, estimated_daily_gb and recommended_min_gb. Same formula as bloomyesim.com/data-calculator: daily MB per activity x days x Wi-Fi factor x 1.15 safety buffer, rounded up.

activities.description: Required. What mobile data will be used for, e.g. ["maps", "messaging", "video"]. hotspot_light / hotspot_heavy mean sharing the connection with another device.

days.description: Required. Trip length in days, integer 1 to 180.

wifi.description: How often hotel or cafe Wi-Fi replaces mobile data: rarely, sometimes (default) or often.

name: estimate_data
title: Estimate data needed
